name: AriaOS Network Radar, LAN Scanner & Private DNS
description: Local network neighbor discovery (ARP/NDP), encrypted/private DNS switching (Cloudflare, Quad9, Mullvad), and multi-endpoint latency radar.

tools.name: scan_lan_devices
tools.description: Discover devices connected to the local LAN/Wi-Fi via ARP table (/proc/net/arp, ip neigh).

tools.name: dns_privacy_status
tools.description: Inspect active DNS resolvers, anti-tracking profile, and encrypted DNS configuration.

tools.name: set_secure_dns
tools.description: Switch system DNS resolvers to a privacy-first or high-speed provider (cloudflare, quad9, mullvad, google, dhcp).

tools.name: latency_radar
tools.description: Measure network round-trip latency and jitter across major global DNS and cloud backbone nodes.
